note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, two key-word moments, one top text and the three kinetic lines, so 5 graphics and the end card. The blog post is a screen recording, not a graphic.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: We published our own mistake.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Name super
mg.use: Put it on 1 s into the row for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Make it large.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words one at a time as she says them, top band: We ask questions / we check the records.
mg.use: Each line lands on her word, near the end of the row. Top band. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text as she says it, 3 s, top band: We audited the operational processes.
mg.use: Put it on when she says it, about 15 s into the row. Hold 3 s.

mg.title: Three phrases
mg.cue: Three kinetic lines, one at a time as she says each one, top band: Here's where something broke. / Here's what we found. / Here's what we're changing.
mg.use: Each line lands on her word. Each holds until the next one. Captions stay on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: watsi.org, all lowercase, Lato, navy #2E2844. One line. Nothing else.
mg.src: Watsi's own end card words from the script (watsi.org, the Who Gives close, or the Watsi x AYH lines). Watsi's scripts say no logo lockup. Source: endcards/index.json, 6 Oct 2026.
